commitResults.messageTitle: Replace unsupported export extensions with .json
commitResults.messageBody:
Keep exported filenames consistent with the JSON backup format by replacing the final unsupported extension instead of appending another suffix. Preserve existing JSON extensions and clarify the final format and path in feedback and documentation.

Cover filename replacement, dotted directories, hidden filenames, and backup reloads. Validated with Java 25: 624 tests and both Checkstyle checks passed.

commitResults.messageTitle: Require Y/N confirmation before overwriting an export
commitResults.messageBody:
Warn users when an export destination already exists and wait for an explicit Y before replacing it. N cancels without writing, while invalid responses repeat the prompt. Stage replacement content in a temporary file before moving it to the destination to avoid truncating the previous backup on write failure.

Document the confirmation flow and test warning, acceptance, cancellation, invalid responses, and overwrite failures. Validated with Java 25: all 626 tests and both Checkstyle checks passed.
